title: Family of Tasered man sues
article: The family of an Italian immigrant who died in police custody is suing city police.
Claudio Castagnetta, 32, was shot with a Taser and arrested for public disorder on Sept. 18, 2007, outside a convenience store.
Castagnetta's family doesn't support the findings of a coroner who said the Taser played no role in the death.
The coroner concluded Castagnetta died of swelling of the brain. The man banged his head repeatedly on the wall of a police van.
He was taken to the hospital several hours later, but he was already in the coma. He died the next day.
The Quebec Crown prosecutor ruled last summer no criminal charges would be laid in the case.
